3.name: MAP KEY
3.text: [map]-- MAP GOES HERE-- make sure the right margin is straight, -- or there will be crashes. map=w7w.6....  map=www...... map=..a..TT.. map=w8..b..._ map=9w0...___ map=.....__._ map=.T_.__... map=..2__..1. map=....__...-- optional CENTER position for when level starts--   if left out, level will start on middle of map center=5,4--   this will center 5 tiles from left, 4 from top--   i.e. the letter 'b' in this map.-- MAP TERRAIN KEY--   M = mountain--   . = normal--   w = water--   _ = normal, undiggable (rocky)--   x = water, unfillable (deep)--   r = water with reefs--   T = tree--   # = swamp--   ^ = volcano--   @ = hole--   ~ = space bar billboard - should be to right of a hole [mapitems]-- RESOURCES, PLANS, UNITS, MONSTERS, GOALS-- make up a key letter or number --        that's not already taken above---- place that letter on the map --   (you can put it in more than one place)  ---- put an entry for a unit, resource, monster, or goal as below-- UNITS LOOK LIKE THIS:-- note that robots and animals are all "vehicles"--   "unit" will be on NORMAL terrain--   "waterunit" will be on WATER terrain0=unit,vehicle,dirtbuggy9=waterunit,vehicle,duck8=waterunit,building,marina-- MONSTERS LOOK LIKE THIS7=unit,monster,crab6=waterunit,monster,crab-- RESOURCE PILES LOOK LIKE THIS:a=pile,yellow,10, wheel,4,energy,1c=pile,blue,5d=pile,yellow,10e=pile,wheel,4f=pile,energy,1h=pile,yellow,1-- PLANS LOOK LIKE THIS:--   "unit" will be on NORMAL terrain--   "waterplan" will be on WATER terrainb=plan,dirtbuggy,10j=waterplan,duck,5-- GOALS LOOK LIKE THIS:--  yes, syntax is inconsistent with other things:--   if you want a goal to be on water, add ",water"1=goal,dirtbuggy2=bonusgoal,buggy3=bonusgoal,duck,water[inventory]-- IF THE LEVEL STARTS WITH ANY PLANS

1.name: vehicle.buggy.description
1.text: A basic land vehicle that can carry up to 3 bricks.Terrain: NormalSpeed: FastActions: Pick Up, Drop OffCapacity: 3 Bricks

2.name: vehicle.dirtbuggy.description
2.text: Extra-big tires get the Dirtbuggy over rough terrain. Carries 3 bricks. Use the spacebar to pick up and drop off loads.Terrain: Normal,RockySpeed: FastActions: Pick Up, Drop OffCapacity: 3 Bricks

3.name: vehicle.duck.description
3.text: A yellow creature that can travel over land and water. And it's amphibious, too!Terrain: Normal,WaterSpeed: FastActions: None

4.name: vehicle.snail.description
4.text: You'd be slow too if you had to carry your entire house on your back.Terrain: NormalSpeed: Very SlowActions: None

5.name: vehicle.fish.description
5.text: This slippery critter lives in the water, which is not unusual - for a fish. Terrain: Water, DeepWaterSpeed: FastActions: None

6.name: vehicle.steamshovel.description
6.text: Use the steamshovel to dig up ground, turning it into water. You can also fill water, turning it into ground. Use the spacebar to dig and fill.Terrain: NormalSpeed: MediumActions: Dig, Fill

7.name: vehicle.treebot.description
7.text: It may take a lot of bricks, but this mighty mech can pull up trees and replant them in the ground. Use the spacebar.Terrain: NormalSpeed: MediumActions: UprootTree, Plant Tree

8.name: vehicle.forklift.description
8.text: The forklift moves a little slow, but it can carry a whopping 10 bricks. Terrain: NormalSpeed: MediumActions: Pick Up,Drop OffCapacity: 10

9.name: vehicle.tugboat.description
9.text: This sturdy vessel is guaranteed not to sink... much. Use the spacebar to pick up and drop off loads.Terrain: Water, DeepWaterSpeed: MediumActions: Pick Up,Drop OffCapacity: 10

10.name: vehicle.dozer.description
10.text: The Dozer can push boulders and piles of bricks. Move next to the target, press the spacebar, and click on the target.Terrain: NormalSpeed: MediumActions: Push

11.name: vehicle.defender.description
11.text: Use the Defender to disassemble pesky monsters.Terrain: NormalSpeed: MediumActions: Disassemble

12.name: vehicle.frog.description
12.text: Frogs are small, green, and entirely made out of LEGO bricks.Terrain: Normal, Shallow WaterSpeed: FastActions: None

13.name: building.gas_station.description
13.text: The Gas Station recharges anything with wheels. Just drive up next to the Station to recharge.Actions: Automatically refuels things with wheels

14.name: vehicle.freighter.description
14.text: This massive vessel can hold plenty of LEGO brick cargo. Use the spacebar to pick up and drop off loads.Terrain: Water, DeepWaterSpeed: MediumActions: Pick Up,Drop OffCapacity: 25

15.name: building.marina.description
15.text: The Marina recharges boats. Just float up next to the Marina to recharge.Actions: Automatically refuels boats.

16.name: vehicle.repairbot.description
16.text: This handy little mechanic loves to fix broken machinery.Terrain: NormalSpeed: FastActions: Automatically recharges any robotit is standing next to.

17.name: vehicle.defender2.description
17.text: DEFENDER MACH 2 DESCRIPTIONTerrain: NormalSpeed: MediumActions: Attack

18.name: building.robot_lab.description
18.text: The Robot Lab recharges robots. Just walk up next to the Lab to recharge.Actions: Automatically repairs robots.

19.name: vehicle.dumptruck.description
19.text: The Dumptruck is slow and steady and can carry a heavy load. Use the spacebar to pick up and drop off loads.Terrain: Normal, RockySpeed: SlowActions: Pick Up, Drop Off

20.name: vehicle.speedboat.description
20.text: Fast and furious, the speedboat has turbo-charged maneuverability and packs a nice defensive wallop.Terrain: Water, Deep WaterSpeed: FastActions: Disassemble

22.name: building.guard_tower.description
22.text: A sturdy defensive outpost that will fight back when monsters try to dismantle it.Actions: Automatically attacks monsters.

23.name: building.house.description
23.text: People live here... or maybe robots do. Or ducks. I'm not sure, what do you think?Actions: None

24.name: building.factory.description
24.text: If you put a boulder or a tree next to the factory, it'll process it into bricks of whatever color the factory displays.Actions: Change color

25.name: building.windmill.description
25.text: The Windmill harnesses air power to automatically churn out energy bricks. It will make more as long as there are no energy bricks next to it already, and it has an empty space to put one in.Actions: None.

26.name: building.garage.description
26.text: The Garage specializes in making tires. It'll produce a pile in an empty square next to it, as long as there aren't any tires next to it already.Actions: None.

27.name: building.nursery.description
27.text: The Nursery is a center for growing trees. If any of the spaces next to it is empty, a tree will sprout there!Actions: None.

28.name: vehicle.freezebot.description
28.text: He's not the toughest robot, so he just freezes any enemy that gets within two paces! His freeze ray has a short recharge time...Terrain: NormalSpeed: FastActions: None (Automatically freezesnearby enemies)
